items.title: The matching-face formula for the diagonal of Loday associahedra
items.author: Naruki Masuda; Hugh Thomas; Andy Tonks; Bruno Vallette
items.source_version: Journal de l’École polytechnique — Mathématiques 8 (2021), publisher version, DOI 10.5802/jep.142
items.difficulty_reason: The full geometric-combinatorial chain must establish weighted face/product structure, realize the diagonal as a tight fiber-minimum subdivision, exclude nonmatching cells by Boolean leaf data and product-facet dimension induction, and prove the reverse inclusion by classifying neighboring faces and propagating inside a Boolean fiber. The newly explicit classical Tamari face-interval fact supplies only order convexity, not any specialized diagonal step. One complete independent reader supports H3 on these obligations; a second independent substantive H3 review is still required.

primary.label: Theorem 2 Magical formula including native illustration

proof_spans.label: weighted Loday realizations and full face/product structure proof
positive orientation and full fiber-minimum diagonal construction
complete two-step proof with all local lemmas and induction
